title: India output PPI contributions by product
description: Contributions of the 74 product categories of manufactured products in the output PPI (2022-23 base) to manufactured products PPI y/y, pp, monthly from April 2024: weight x (index - index a year earlier) / (manufactured products weight x its index a year earlier); weight as a share of manufactured products (%); y/y and contributions calculated from the Office of the Economic Adviser's indices. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (in_ppi_oea, data/in/ppi/in_ppi_contrib_items.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly release (14th) by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
